title: Spike damage wraps score below zero to ~65136 instead of clamping at 0
observed: After collecting a coin (score 100) and then stepping on spikes at (3,3), score shows 65136 (65536 - 400), i.e. the subtraction wrapped around. From a score of 0, a spike hit gives 65036.
expected: Spikes cost 500 points but the score never goes below 0, so the score should read 0 after the spike hit.
